item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera watches different objects in motion around her home and school. She wants to identify which one shows oscillatory motion — motion that moves to and fro about a fixed position.
Which of the following is an example of oscillatory motion?

options.A: The minute hand of the wall clock moving around the dial
options.B: The swing in the park moving back and forth after Rohan pushes it
options.C: A ball rolling in a straight line across the classroom floor
options.D: A bus travelling from Chennai to Madurai along a highway
